content_sections.heading: MANUU Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates should download and read the MANUU Jobs 2026 notification PDF carefully to check vacancy details, eligibility, age limit, and application instructions. The notification also includes important dates and selection process details. The direct download link is available in the Important Links section below. Download MANUU Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: MANUU Vacancy Details 2026
content_sections.text: A total of 6 vacancies are available – 2 for Medical Laboratory Sciences (MLS), 2 for Medical Radiology & Imaging Technology (MRIT), and 2 for Emergency Medical Technology (EMT).

content_sections.heading: MANUU Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Medical Laboratory Sciences (MLS) & Medical Radiology & Imaging Technology (MRIT): M.D. in Radiology, Nuclear Medicine, Radiotherapy, Biochemistry, Microbiology, Anatomy, Pathology, Physiology, Blood Transfusion, Hematology or M.Sc. Radio Imaging Technology/Medical Lab Technology/Medical with teaching experience (as per MCI/NMC or UGC norms). Knowledge of Urdu is compulsory. Emergency Medical Technology (EMT): MBBS/MD/MS in Emergency Medicine/Anesthesia/General Medicine/General Surgery/Orthopedics or M.Sc Nursing/Emergency & Trauma Care Technology/Trauma Care Management or Medical Graduate with additional qualifications in Emergency Medicine or M.B.B.S with 5 years experience (with ACLS/ATLS). Knowledge of Urdu is compulsory.

content_sections.heading: MANUU Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Please refer to the official notification for age limit details.

content_sections.heading: MANUU Recruitment 2026 - Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for MANUU Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for MANUU Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Guest Faculty positions at MANUU is scheduled for 14 August 2026. Candidates should ensure they report to the venue on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies for Guest Faculty at MANUU?
faq.answer: Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU) has announced a total of 6 vacancies for the Guest Faculty positions across various departments.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Guest Faculty posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications vary by post but generally include M.D. in relevant medical fields, M.Sc., MBBS/MD/MS, M.Sc. Nursing, Ph.D. preferred, and NET/SLET/SET. Knowledge of Urdu is compulsory for all positions.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Guest Faculty positions will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000 per month.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for MANUU Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What is the mode of application for this MANUU recruitment?
faq.answer: The mode of application is a Walk-in Interview. Candidates need to attend the interview directly at the specified venue and time.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview be conducted?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Maulana Azad National Urdu University (MANUU) in Hyderabad, Telangana, with the pincode 500032.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates, and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Is there an age limit for the Guest Faculty positions?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify an age limit for these Guest Faculty positions. Candidates are advised to check the detailed notification.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the MANUU Guest Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification.
